rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go: the top-level `fak cache-value status` report that folds every cache-economics source (kernel/savings/usage ledgers, vCache snapshots and sub-reports) into one verdict with rows and next actions.
rows.distinction: The AGGREGATE cache-VALUE status report (economics rollup) - NOT the KV cache (the tensor store) and NOT a single cachevalueStatusRow line inside it.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go: one row of the cache-value status report - a single named cache-economics line item (source, value, dash-or-detail) rendered in the status table.
rows.distinction: ONE row of the status table - NOT cachevalueStatus (the whole report) and NOT cachevalueFailureDomain (which classifies where a row's failure lives).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status_render.go: classifies a cache-value row's failure into an owner/component domain string, so the status report attributes a missing or bad value to the subsystem responsible.
rows.distinction: A FAILURE-ATTRIBUTION classifier (which subsystem owns this gap) - NOT cachevalueEmptyDash (which just renders a blank as '-') and NOT a status row itself.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/ablate.go: a tiny formatter that renders an empty cache-value string (e.g. a missing workload hash) as '-' so a blank never reads as a real value.
rows.distinction: A pure display FORMATTER (empty -> '-') - NOT cachevalueFailureDomain (which diagnoses WHY it is empty) and NOT a status row.

rows.definition: internal/gateway/session_admit.go: the count of tokens the provider billed for WRITING a new cache entry (from the upstream CacheCreationInputTokens), tracked by the spend governor.
rows.distinction: Tokens billed to CREATE a cache entry - NOT observedCacheReadTokens (tokens served FROM cache) and NOT cacheablePrefixTokens (the eligible-to-cache prefix); write side, not read side.

rows.definition: internal/agent/compact_receipt.go: the provider-OBSERVED count of input tokens served from cache on a call, recorded on the compaction receipt.
rows.distinction: Tokens the provider reported READING from cache - NOT CacheWriteTokens (cache-creation billing) and NOT cacheablePrefixTokens (the prefix eligible to cache before any read happens).

rows.definition: internal/cacheobs/cacheobs.go ObserveSplit param: the number of prompt-prefix tokens ELIGIBLE to be cached on a call, split out from the total prompt tokens and the actually-reused prefix.
rows.distinction: The ELIGIBLE-to-cache prefix length (an intent) - NOT observedCacheReadTokens (what was actually read) and NOT CacheWriteTokens (what a write was billed).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/dojo.go: a dojo RSI-loop CLAIM - the fraction (seeded ~0.8, recalibrated toward measured) of billed input-side tokens (input + cache_read + cache_creation) served as cache reads across the whole multi-provider corpus.
rows.distinction: A corpus-wide predicted FRACTION the RSI loop recalibrates - NOT ObservedCacheReadTokens (a single call's raw count) and NOT CacheWriteTokens; it is a ratio claim, not a per-call counter.

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_planner.go: the always-uncacheable planner cases (e.g. a planner running without a prefix KV) that book zero cache benefit because no reusable prefix exists.
rows.distinction: The NO-REUSABLE-PREFIX condition (books zero) - NOT cacheablePrefixTokens (a non-zero eligible prefix) and NOT featureUncachedTrim (an ablation knob); it names a case, not a knob.

rows.definition: internal/ablate/ablate.go: the ablation feature name 'uncached_trim' - the toggle whose effect on the workload is measured when trimming context that would not have been cache-hit anyway.
rows.distinction: An ABLATION KNOB name (a feature under A/B measurement) - NOT the uncacheable planner case (a runtime condition) and NOT a token counter.

rows.definition: internal/deepseekv4moe/cache_capacity.go ExpertCachePlan: the computed plan for how many routed MoE experts fit resident in HBM given the total/non-routed/reserve byte budget.
rows.distinction: The static CAPACITY PLAN (how many experts fit) - NOT ExpertCacheTrace (the simulated hit/miss trace of a route stream) and NOT the KV cache; it is a residency budget, not a run.

rows.definition: internal/deepseekv4moe/cache_trace.go ExpertCacheTrace: the trace of expert-cache hits and misses produced by replaying a route stream against a capacity.
rows.distinction: The simulated HIT/MISS TRACE (a run's outcome) - NOT ExpertCachePlan (the static residency budget) and NOT SimulateExpertCache (the func that produces the trace).

rows.definition: internal/deepseekv4moe/cache_capacity.go PlanExpertCache: computes an ExpertCachePlan from the HBM byte budget (total, non-routed resident, runtime reserve, routed-expert group size, layers, experts-per-layer).
rows.distinction: The FUNC that computes the residency plan - NOT ExpertCachePlan (its result struct) and NOT SimulateExpertCache (which replays routes against that plan's capacity).

rows.definition: internal/deepseekv4moe/cache_trace.go SimulateExpertCache: replays a route stream against a fixed expert-cache capacity (layers, experts-per-layer, topK) to produce an ExpertCacheTrace.
rows.distinction: The SIMULATION func (routes -> hit/miss trace) - NOT PlanExpertCache (which sizes the capacity) and NOT ExpertCacheTrace (the trace it returns).

rows.definition: internal/agent/anthropic_compact.go rangeHasCacheControl: reports whether a message-element range carries an Anthropic cache_control breakpoint, so compaction never splits across a live cache boundary.
rows.distinction: A PROBE over Anthropic cache_control breakpoints in a message range - NOT responsesPromptCacheKey (the OpenAI Responses cache key) and NOT a token counter.

rows.definition: internal/agent/adapters.go responsesPromptCacheKey: derives the OpenAI Responses API prompt_cache_key (from model, messages, tools) that routes a request to a stable server-side prefix cache.
rows.distinction: The OpenAI Responses PROMPT-CACHE KEY derivation - NOT rangeHasCacheControl (Anthropic cache_control breakpoints) and NOT prefixCacheIdentityFromContext (the in-kernel prefix identity); it is provider-cache addressing.

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_decode.go prefixCacheIdentityFromContext: extracts the owner and scoped identity of the in-kernel prefix cache from a request context, so a decode reuses the right prefix KV.
rows.distinction: The IN-KERNEL prefix-cache identity extractor - NOT responsesPromptCacheKey (a provider-side cache key) and NOT the KV cache tensors themselves; it names WHICH prefix, not the bytes.

rows.definition: internal/gateway/vcache_score.go: the vCache SCORE report (a vcachescore.Report) grading how well the modeled virtual cache is performing, folded into cache-value status.
rows.distinction: The vCache SCORE grade - NOT vcacheObserveReport (raw observations), NOT the vCache context-join/witness reports; it is the graded verdict over vCache, one of several vCache sub-reports.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go: the filesystem PATH source for the vCache OBSERVE report (raw observed vCache reuse events) that cache-value status folds in.
rows.distinction: The path to the OBSERVE (raw events) report - NOT vcacheScoreReport (the graded verdict) and NOT VCacheContextJoinReport (the context-join artifact).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go: the filesystem PATH source for the vCache CONTEXT-JOIN report (how the modeled cache joins against the live context) folded into cache-value status.
rows.distinction: The CONTEXT-JOIN report path - NOT VCacheObserveReport (raw observations) and NOT VCacheContextWitnessReport (the witness artifact); each is a distinct vCache sub-report file.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go + cachevalue_status_vcachewitness.go: the PATH source for the vCache CONTEXT-WITNESS report, whose rows witness that a modeled vCache context matched the real one; rowsFromVCacheContextWitnessReport turns it into status rows.
rows.distinction: The context-WITNESS report path (proof the model matched reality) - NOT VCacheContextJoinReport (the join computation) and NOT VCacheContextSnapshot (a point-in-time state dump).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status.go + cachevalue_status_session.go: the vCache CONTEXT SNAPSHOT dependency - a point-in-time dump of the modeled virtual-cache context state that the status report and session analysis read.
rows.distinction: A point-in-time STATE SNAPSHOT (the input) - NOT VCacheContextWitnessReport (the proof it matched reality) and NOT VCacheContextJoinReport (the join computation over it).
